  WHY: Reviewers treated this as a robustness/style issue rather than a correctness bug, and one reviewer explicitly judged the risk negligible; the consensus keeps the lowest severity category raised.

  WHY: Two reviewers flagged the update as potentially unrelated, while other reviewers disagreed and said it is still relevant; the consensus preserves the concern with the highest reported severity.
